outcome: Myocardial infarction with nonobstructive coronary arteries
cohort: A single 39-year-old postpartum woman who presented with acute anterior myocardial infarction.
finding: Coronary computed tomography angiogram (CCTA) can effectively demonstrate intramural hematoma, confirming the diagnosis of SCAD and should be considered as part of the workup and follow-up for SCAD.
